ad_info.structure_source: library format F63 (Person with the problem on the left, symptom list and bottle on a pedestal) — structure np-07
ad_info.reference_style: Real-photo supplement ad: frustrated person, three icon symptoms, product on pedestal over a colored wave, promise pill
ad_info.angle_used: Pain / problem: women who train legs and don't see the change

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (bottom wave, icon circles, pill), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (giant first headline line and icon labels), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE (pedestal), white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: cool gym grey-blue #DDE3EA light, concrete grey #A7ADB4 and black rubber #2A2A2A.
global_identity.visual_style: Real photographic ad: a real woman in a neighborhood gym, natural skin, combined with clean flat graphic elements and the real bottle, sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Honest frustration after a workout that turns into a hopeful solution.
global_identity.graphic_language: One big curved fuchsia wave across the lower part, three solid fuchsia circles with white thin-line icons, a round pedestal, one rounded pill with an icon.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; icon labels and pill in Poppins SemiBold / Bold.

creative_objective: Mirror the exact frustration of the woman who does squats and still has loose jeans, list her three pains, and place the bottle as the support for her leg routine.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Giant 'SENTADILLAS'. 2) 'Y EL JEAN SIGUE SUELTO' and the frustrated woman. 3) The three pain icons. 4) The bottle on its pedestal. 5) The pill and the seal line.
art_direction.composition_style: Headline centered across the top 28%; woman on the left 50% from the waist up; icons stacked in the center-right; bottle on a pedestal at the lower right over the wave; pill at the lower left over the wave.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Icons aligned left with their labels to the right, even spacing; the wave rises from the lower left to the right, cutting the woman at the waist; seal line at the bottom right edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Cool soft window light from the upper left on the woman (gym daylight), background blurred; the bottle lit by a soft studio key from the left with a small contact shadow on the pedestal.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 28%: 3-line headline, first line giant and darker, two more lines in a second color. Left: a real person from the waist up with a hand on the forehead, eyes closed, frustrated. Center-right: three icons inside solid circles stacked vertically with a short label each. Bottom: a big colored wave; the bottle on a round pedestal at the lower right; a rounded pill with an icon and the promise at the lower left.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Woman in gym clothes sitting on a bench after training, hand on forehead
Jeans, leg and battery icons with the plan's labels
Real closed bottle on a round blush pedestal
'Acompaña tu rutina de pierna' with a dumbbell icon
Small white line on the wave

forbidden_additions: Price, offer, stars, testimonials or customer counts
A CTA button different from the promise pill
Loose capsules, open bottle or leaves next to the bottle

visual_prompt:
Square 1:1 real-photo ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; ignore any hand or surface in that photo. If a layout reference image is attached, use it ONLY for the position of the blocks; never copy its text, brand, product, person or colors.

BACKGROUND: a small neighborhood gym in Colombia, blurred (f/2): a high window letting in cool daylight on the upper left, light grey-blue walls #DDE3EA, a rack of black rubber dumbbells #2A2A2A and a squat rack softly out of focus, concrete grey floor #A7ADB4. The upper area is light and airy so the headline reads clearly.

TOP (0-28% of height): centered headline in three lines, very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase. Line 1 'SENTADILLAS' giant, about 90% of the width, dark plum #2B1226. Lines 2 and 3 smaller, in hot fuchsia #E6177F: 'Y EL JEAN' and 'SIGUE SUELTO'.

CENTER-LEFT (28-100%, left 50% of width): a real Colombian woman of about 29, warm olive-brown skin with visible pores and a light sheen of sweat on the forehead and collarbones, dark hair in a messy high ponytail with loose strands, wearing a dusty-rose sports bra-top under an open grey zip hoodie and black leggings. She sits on a padded gym bench, shown from the waist up, facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, her right hand on her forehead, eyes closed, brows pulled together, mouth tense: tired frustration after training. Plano medio, 35 mm lens at eye level. The fuchsia wave cuts her at the waist.

CENTER-RIGHT (30-62%, from 50% to 80% of width): three stacked rows, evenly spaced. Each row: a solid hot fuchsia #E6177F circle about 9% of the width with a white thin-line icon, and to its right a two-line label in Poppins Bold, dark plum #2B1226. Row 1: jeans icon, 'Jean suelto atrás'. Row 2: leg icon, 'Piernas delgadas'. Row 3: low battery icon, 'Sin energía para entrenar'.

BOTTOM (62-100%): a large smooth hot fuchsia #E6177F wave rising from the lower left toward the right, with a darker magenta #B0105E edge line. Lower right (55-95% of height): ONE closed bottle on a round pale blush #FBE3EE pedestal, the bottle about 34% of the canvas height, label facing the camera, straight on, fully legible and never mirrored, photographic and sharp: matte black cylinder about 1.6 times taller than wide, straight sides, no neck, wide glossy hot-pink cap almost as wide as the body with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with the huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1', the pink banner, italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and the three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE + 400mg FENOGRECO + 200mg MACA NEGRA'; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Lower left (84-94%): a rounded dark plum #2B1226 pill about 45% of the width with a white circle holding a fuchsia dumbbell icon at its left, and the text 'Acompaña tu rutina de pierna' in white Poppins Bold, with 'rutina de pierna' heavier. Very bottom right (96-99%), small white Poppins SemiBold on the wave: 'AGREGAR LOGO Y SELLO DE REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.

mandatory_visual_elements: Real frustrated woman in gym clothes on a bench, hand on forehead, waist up on the left
Three fuchsia circles with white line icons stacked center-right
Hot fuchsia wave across the lower part
The real closed bottle on a round pedestal at the lower right, label legible
Dark plum pill with a dumbbell icon at the lower left
final_generation_exclusions: No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle, no leaves next to the bottle.
No question marks in the headline.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. The headline describes a common situation, not the reader's body; the promise is 'acompaña', not a guaranteed result.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
